# Slobodan Jelisavac - Google Ads Consultant (a Google Ads partner, not an agency)

> Independent senior Google Ads consultant based in Nova Pazova and Batajnica, Serbia; Partner at Funky Enterprises. 10+ years of experience; campaigns he worked on won 3 UK Search Awards; 50+ brands across 6+ countries. Runs Search, Shopping, Performance Max, and early-access ChatGPT Ads for eCommerce, B2B, and SaaS brands across Serbia, the UK, the EU, and the US, including a UK skincare brand run for more than two years at 1.78x POAS on six-figure revenue in GBP (client name and exact revenue withheld under NDA). Works with eCommerce brands spending roughly $10k-100k/month: helps them work out exactly what a sale is allowed to cost, then runs the account to that ceiling. No juniors, no account managers, no long-term lock-in contracts; every account is run by Slobodan personally, increasingly with the help of his own AI-assisted workflow for the repetitive parts. Optimizes for POAS (profit on ad spend), not headline ROAS.

> Two ways of working: advisory (consulting from $200/hr | €150/sat; Deep Audit + Action Plan for accounts spending $5,000+/month, priced by market: Serbia €450, EU €750, UK £750, Australia $1,200 AUD, US $1,500) and full management (eCommerce Growth from $2,500/mo for brands spending $10k+/month | Serbian market: from €700/mo for budgets of €1,500+/mo; omnichannel Performance Marketing via a Funky Enterprises partnership - Google Ads, Meta, SEO, and CRO together - for market leaders). A free 15-minute video account review is available for qualifying accounts (ad spend $1,500+/month or GBP/EUR equivalent, limited to 5 per month); everyone else can book a free 20-minute intro call.

This site is a free resource hub for Serbian- and English-speaking advertisers covering Google Ads strategy, Google Shopping, Performance Max, ChatGPT Ads, the Google Ads API, conversion tracking, remarketing, POAS/profit-based bidding, and PPC fundamentals. All content is original, written by a practitioner, based on real client accounts. The full text of the key pages listed below (services, audit, about, the healthcare industry page, Insights, and the top 10 guides by Search Console clicks) is available at /llms-full.txt.

## About

- [About Slobodan](https://www.slobodan-jelisavac.com/en/about): 10+ years running Google Ads accounts personally, no juniors or templates; came up through Belgrade agencies, then Launchpresso (Thailand-based, Australian-owned) and Exposure Ninja (UK); campaigns he worked on won 3 UK Search Awards; today an independent consultant and Partner at Funky Enterprises
- [Contact](https://www.slobodan-jelisavac.com/en/contact): Free 20-minute intro call; he will say plainly if he cannot help
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.slobodan-jelisavac.com/en/privacy)

## Services

- [Google Ads Management](https://www.slobodan-jelisavac.com/en/services/google-ads-management): End-to-end management, personally run - from $2,500/mo for brands spending $10k+/month | Serbian market: from €700/mo for budgets of €1,500+/mo
- [Google Ads Agency](https://www.slobodan-jelisavac.com/en/services/google-ads-agency): Senior-led boutique alternative to a full agency team - no junior account managers, the client owns the ad account
- [Google Ads Audit](https://www.slobodan-jelisavac.com/en/services/google-ads-audit): Deep Audit + Action Plan for accounts spending $5,000+/month, priced by market - UK £750, EU €750, Australia $1,200 AUD, US $1,500, Serbia €450
- [ChatGPT Ads](https://www.slobodan-jelisavac.com/en/services/chatgpt-ads): Early-access placements inside ChatGPT, built on the same tracking and measurement discipline used on Google Ads accounts
- [Google Ads for eCommerce](https://www.slobodan-jelisavac.com/en/services/google-ads-for-ecommerce): Shopping, Performance Max, and full-funnel strategy for online stores
- [Google Ads for B2B](https://www.slobodan-jelisavac.com/en/services/google-ads-for-b2b): Lead generation and CRM-connected tracking (HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive) for companies with a defined sales process
- [Google Ads for SaaS](https://www.slobodan-jelisavac.com/en/services/google-ads-for-saas): Trial-to-paid funnels, CAC and LTV framing for subscription products
- [Consultations](https://www.slobodan-jelisavac.com/en/services/consultations): 1-on-1 strategy sessions ($200/hr | €150/sat, 3-hour package $600 | €450) for in-house teams, founders, and second opinions
- [Free Audit Video Review](https://www.slobodan-jelisavac.com/en/audit): Free 15-minute personalized video review (not a template) for qualifying accounts - ad spend $1,500+/month (or GBP/EUR equivalent), active account for 3+ months, read-only access provided before the call; limited to 5 per month, 48-hour turnaround

## Pillar / Cornerstone Content (2026)

- [Google Ads for eCommerce in Serbia 2026](https://www.slobodan-jelisavac.com/en/blog/google-ads-for-ecommerce-serbia-2026): Data-driven strategy guide using NBS data, CPC benchmarks per category, urban vs rural strategy, and a prep checklist for the Shopping Ads launch
- [Google Shopping Launches in Serbia: Complete Preparation Guide](https://www.slobodan-jelisavac.com/en/blog/google-shopping-serbia-2026): Merchant Center setup, feed optimization, account requirements, and a pre-launch preparation timeline
- [Google Merchant Center Setup for Serbia](https://www.slobodan-jelisavac.com/sr/blog/merchant-center-srbija-setup): Step-by-step Merchant Center guide for the Serbian market (Serbian; MC registration for Serbia was not yet open as of this guide's last update)
- [Product Feed Guide for Serbian eCommerce](https://www.slobodan-jelisavac.com/sr/blog/product-feed-srpski-ecommerce): Feed anatomy, title optimization, custom labels, per-platform feed generation - launch-prep work merchants can do before Merchant Center opens (Serbian)
- [Google Ads Updates 2026 (Living Post)](https://www.slobodan-jelisavac.com/en/blog/google-ads-updates-2026): Ongoing changelog of Google Ads platform changes through the year, including the September 2026 DSA/broad-match migration
- [Google Ads API Basic Access Guide](https://www.slobodan-jelisavac.com/en/blog/google-ads-api-basic-access-guide): What changed September 9, 2026, brand verification screen by screen, and what Basic Access does and does not give you

- [Google Ads vs Meta Ads](https://www.slobodan-jelisavac.com/en/blog/google-ads-vs-meta-ads): Channel comparison
- [Google Ads for eCommerce vs B2B](https://www.slobodan-jelisavac.com/en/blog/google-ads-ecommerce-vs-b2b): Strategy differences
- [Responsive Search Ads (RSA) Framework](https://www.slobodan-jelisavac.com/en/blog/responsive-search-ads-guide): 7-8 headlines vs 15, angle-based testing
- [Smart Bidding Strategies Guide](https://www.slobodan-jelisavac.com/en/blog/smart-bidding-guide): tCPA vs tROAS, when to switch from manual, minimum conversion thresholds
- [Microsoft Ads vs Google Ads](https://www.slobodan-jelisavac.com/en/blog/microsoft-ads-vs-google-ads-comparison): Market share and CPC differences from 2 years running both in parallel

- [What is ROAS and How to Calculate It](https://www.slobodan-jelisavac.com/en/blog/what-is-roas): Formula, interactive calculator, ROAS vs POAS
- [POAS vs ROAS - Profit-Based Bidding](https://www.slobodan-jelisavac.com/en/blog/poas-vs-roas): Why a high ROAS can still lose money, break-even math, and how to feed profit data to Smart Bidding
- [Offline Conversion Import for B2B](https://www.slobodan-jelisavac.com/en/blog/offline-conversion-import-b2b): Connecting Google Ads to a CRM so the algorithm learns from closed deals, not form fills
- [GA4 Audience Framework for Repeat-Purchase Ecommerce](https://www.slobodan-jelisavac.com/en/blog/ga4-audiences-ecommerce-framework): 25-list audience framework with delivery thresholds and GA4 configuration per list
- [Merchant Center Feed Scorecard](https://www.slobodan-jelisavac.com/en/blog/merchant-center-feed-scorecard): Scoring your product feed before it becomes a Shopping/PMax problem
- [Product Feed Guide for Serbian eCommerce](https://www.slobodan-jelisavac.com/en/blog/product-feed-serbian-ecommerce): Same feed-anatomy guide as above, English version
- [Google Ads Audit Checklist for Serbia 2026](https://www.slobodan-jelisavac.com/en/blog/google-ads-audit-checklist-serbia-2026): Serbia-specific version of the audit checklist
- [Performance Max Audit Checklist](https://www.slobodan-jelisavac.com/en/blog/performance-max-audit-checklist): PMax-specific checkpoints, also available as an interactive tool (see Resources)
